messages:
lina_cs: Heads-up — BrightMetro (Enterprise, dedicated) flagged as HIGH RISK. Onboarding stalled week 3, NPS 6, and usage down ~45% over the last 7d. Finance has a downgrade-ready contract review next Tue. We need a 48h save plan and immediate blockers list. @mike_csm can you lead the outreach?

mike_csm: On it. Quick Qs: who is the exec sponsor on their side and what exact blockers are causing the stall? I'll try to get a call scheduled today.

jordan_onboarding: Blocker: SSO still failing — reported "SAML metadata mismatch" on their IdP. Logged ENG ticket ENG-4789 and added customer logs. Waiting on customer to upload corrected metadata.

sam_support: Triage note: we pushed a mapping patch to handle the IdP attribute name yesterday. Customer needs to re-upload metadata and then we run a validation. Sent step-by-step at 14:03: https://support.redwood.com/cases/BR-9231

alex_revenue: If they move to downgrade, churn risk to ARR is significant. Suggest we prioritize a 3-month retention offer + committed support SLA if they sign a quick MSA amendment. But retention first, then commercial.

nora_success_ops: Draft 48h save play (quick checklist):
```
- 0-6h: Confirm exec sponsor + schedule 30m rescue call (owner: @mike_csm)
- 6-12h: SSO quick-fix walkthrough with onboarding + support; validate post-upload (owner: @jordan_onboarding + @sam_support)
- 12-24h: Run enablement workshop: two short sessions (admins, engineering). Share 1-pager ROI + success milestones (owner: @lina_cs)
- 24-36h: Deploy monitoring dashboard for usage + alerts; set regression guardrails (owner: @mike_csm)
- 36-48h: Confirm commitment or escalate to account exec for commercial rescue (owner: @alex_revenue)
- Add: Capture friction points in Gainsight/CSM notes and include the customer-supplied SSO logs in ENG ticket.
```

ops-bot: :warning: Automated alert — BrightMetro account health score dropped to 28% (threshold breach). See /alerts/1850123456

lina_cs: I'll run the enablement workshop Wed 10:00 PT (admins) and 11:00 PT (devs). @jordan_onboarding please prepare the SSO walkthrough script and quick checklist. @mike_csm please bring the ROI deck and the success milestone one-pager.

mike_csm: ACK. I'll also stand up a short monitoring board (live view) and a Zap to notify us if key metrics fall during the intervention window. Tasks: create board, add retention metrics, add alert for token-generation < 60%.

sam_support: I'll draft the follow-up email to send immediately after the workshop. Draft snippet: "Thanks for the call — next steps: SSO re-upload, validation, and two enablement tasks. Attaching step-by-step. We will reconvene in 24h to confirm." Will post draft here for review.

lina_cs: Great. Please post the draft and the meeting link once scheduled. If we hit validation success, we propose a 30-day conditional retention credit + weekly checkpoints. :thumbsup:

mike_csm: Scheduling invite sent. Will update ENG-4789 with post-validation logs.

lina_cs: Thanks all — update thread after the call. If we get this fixed quickly we avoid downgrade review.
